descriptionChirho: The primary Qal sense of ידע covering cognitive knowledge of facts, situations, and truth; awareness, perception, and understanding. Includes all inflections (perfect, imperfect, imperative, cohortative, jussive, infinitive construct) across all persons and numbers where the meaning is general knowing/perceiving.

labelChirho: Qal: to know a person, be acquainted with
descriptionChirho: Relational and experiential knowledge of persons; to recognize, be personally acquainted with, or have intimate familiarity with someone. Distinguished from cognitive knowledge by the direct personal object and glosses emphasizing acquaintanceship (Spanish 'conocer', Arabic عَرَفَ).
Euphemistic use of ידע for sexual intercourse, typically 'he knew her/his wife.' Identified by glosses such as 'Y conoció' (spa), 'Na akamjua' (swa), and direct personal objects referring to spouses.
Specialized Qal sense of ידע meaning to discern or distinguish, used in rhetorical questions about the capacity for judgment or discrimination between things.

labelChirho: Qal: knower, one who knows (participle as substantive)
descriptionChirho: Qal active participle used as a substantive noun meaning 'one who knows,' 'knower,' 'those who know,' or 'acquaintances' — persons characterized by their knowledge or relationship.
The Qal infinitive absolute of ידע used adverbially to intensify the verb, yielding meanings such as 'surely know,' 'certainly,' or 'knowing full well.'

labelChirho: Niphal: to be known, become known
descriptionChirho: The Niphal (passive/reflexive) stem of ידע meaning 'to be known,' 'to become known,' 'to be discovered,' or 'to make oneself known.' Covers all Niphal inflections including imperfect, perfect, and conjunctive forms.

labelChirho: Hifil: to make known, inform, declare
descriptionChirho: The Hifil (causative active) stem of ידע meaning 'to cause to know,' 'to make known,' 'to inform,' 'to teach,' or 'to declare.' Covers imperatives, imperfects, perfects, infinitives, and participles in the Hifil.

labelChirho: Hofal: to be made known (causative passive)
descriptionChirho: The Hofal (causative passive) stem of ידע meaning 'to be made known' or 'to be informed.' The passive counterpart of the Hifil causative.

labelChirho: Piel: to cause to know, make to know
descriptionChirho: The Piel (intensive/factitive) stem of ידע meaning 'to cause to know' or 'to make known' — an intensive causative variant. Rare form appearing in ketiv/qere variants.

labelChirho: Hitpael: to make oneself known, reveal oneself
descriptionChirho: The Hitpael (reflexive) stem of ידע meaning 'to make oneself known,' 'to reveal oneself,' or 'to identify oneself' — an active self-disclosure.
The Pual (intensive passive) participle of ידע used as a substantive noun meaning 'acquaintance,' 'known one,' 'kinsman,' or 'close friend.'
The rare Poel stem of ידע with a specialized meaning 'to direct,' 'to designate,' or 'to appoint' — a semantic extension from intimate knowledge to authoritative assignment.
